summary: Smoke test after env change: REACT_APP_STRK20_POOL now empty. Backend /api/status, /api/pubkey, /api/ledger all 200. Frontend boots without JS/React crashes. All 6 bottom nav tabs (nav-harvest, nav-tokens, nav-ledger, nav-universe, nav-device, nav-pool) render and are clickable. Pool tab (PrivacyScreen) renders correctly. pool-address-warning is NOT shown (expected, since empty pool is treated as OK by poolAddressLooksSepolia). No new console errors introduced by empty pool address — only pre-existing React Router v6 future-flag warnings remain. No pageerror observed.
action_items: Review request listed incorrect nav testids (nav-live, nav-shield, nav-attest, nav-settings). Actual testids are nav-harvest, nav-tokens, nav-ledger, nav-universe, nav-device, nav-pool. Update main-agent context accordingly.

The 'Pool fee unavailable until REACT_APP_STRK20_POOL is set' hint lives in the Shield panel which only mounts when a Ready wallet is connected. It cannot be exercised in headless smoke test; user must verify in local browser with Ready extension (as noted in review request).
critical_code_review_comments: PrivacyScreen.poolAddressLooksSepolia treating empty pool as 'OK' is correct for hiding the mainnet warning, but naming is misleading — consider isPoolAddressSafe() or similar.
starknetWallet.fetchPoolFee returning null on empty pool address is graceful; verified no crash on Pool tab load.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Env change REACT_APP_STRK20_POOL='' verified. Backend healthy at https://mobile-app-build-778.preview.emergentagent.com. Nav testids: nav-{harvest,tokens,ledger,universe,device,pool}. Full Shield/pool-fee UI requires Ready wallet extension — cannot be tested headlessly.
